verdict.rationale: The Crawl API pulls data from many linked pages in a single request, and a community comment notes Hyperbrowser offers generous concurrency for parallel browsing. Bulk work across arbitrary item sets, however, is only implied through running many sessions or agent tasks programmatically. Missing for 10: an explicit batch API for an arbitrary list of URLs or items, documented parallel or bulk job orchestration with result aggregation, and hands-on corroboration of bulk runs at scale.
